title: maquira guianensis subsp. costaricana
intro: Maquira guianensis subsp. costaricana, commonly known as a species of tree, is a plant native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial actions, which can help to soothe wounds and fight off infections. The therapeutic actions of Maquira guianensis subsp. costaricana include its ability to reduce inflammation, promote wound healing, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
